s: Din hannachat erub veqinyan shebita ubo seip echad: mippene shettechumin middibre soperim, heqellu bahem, vehittiru lemi shetztzarik lelek d' alapim amma leruach achat meruchot hair sheyyanniach mezon b' seuddot besop alpayim min hair, vezehu hanniqra "erube techumin", shemmeareb hattechumin zeh im zeh. Veyitkavven liqnot shebitato bimqom erubo o samuk lo, bemaqom sheyyukal lehabi lesham erubo beben hashshemashot uleoklo im haya rotzeh lihyot sham ad ben hashshemashot uleoklo, shemmittok kak moil lo erubo liqnot sham shebita beben hashshemashot, shennachshob oto keillu shabat sham, ap al pi sheeno sham ben hashshemashot, lepi sheddato shel adam vedirato bimqom mezonotayv hu, vekevan shemmezonotayv munnachim sham ben hashshemashot — hare zeh keillu hu atzmo shabat sham, veyakol lehallek lemachar mimmeqom erubo alpayim amma lekol ruach, ap al pi sheshshabat velan babbayit. Umikkol maqom, ap shemmistakker beerubo alpayim amma, sheakshav yakol lehallek min hair d' alapim leruach achat — alpayim ad erubo vealpayim lehalea meerubo — hare hu mapsid bo alpayim shemmin hair leruchot acherot, kegon im hinniach erubo lesop alpayim lemizrach hair, en lo mimmeqom erubo ella alpayim lekol ruach im d' qarnayim, shekkol qeren hu gam ken alpayim kemo shennitbaer besimman shtz"t. Nimtza shehaalpayim shellemaarab hem betzad mizrach hair, veeno yakol lehallek chutz leshaar hair letzad tzapon uletzad darom apillu pesia achat, veen tzarik lomar letzad maarab hair. Vaapillu letzad mizracha eno yakol lehallek al pene kullah im hi rechaba yoter mid' alapim ved' ammot, shezzehu shiur shel maarab erubo — alpayim shel rochab qeren tzeponit maarabit vealpayim shel rochab qeren maarabit deromit, ved' ammot benehen keshiur rochab meqom qeniyyat shebitato sheqqoneh lo erubo, shekkol hammanniach erub yesh lo sham d' ammot, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman t"t, keshemmodedim lo alpayim lekol ruach meerubo modedim michutz led' ammot ellu, veachar kak memalleim haqqeranot:
